contentText: US President Donald Trump addressed economic leaders in the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, on January 21, before answering questions. He addressed Greenland, Iran, NATO and the US economy, while lambasting US allies amidst the EU thinking of using its anticoercion instrument as Trump threatens to increase tariffs. FRANCE 24's Angela Diffley and Fraser Jackson break these points down for us.
